report_meta.engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) — DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT
report_meta.title: Self-interest and fairness: self-serving choices of justice principles
report_meta.mode: STATIC audit (no public raw-data deposit; ESM = instructions + appendices, no data). Internal-consistency + derived-value reimplementation in R 4.6.1 and Python 3.8 cross-check.

pipeline.experiment: Dictator game with production: 20-question quiz earning stage (reward rate per correct answer 100/150/200 pesetas randomized) + allocation stage. 144 students (72 dictator observations = 24 per treatment DW/DB/BL). z-Tree.
analysis: Table 1 descriptive statistics (means/SDs/min/max per treatment + pooled)
Table 2: WLS robust (Huber/White sandwich) + bootstrapped median (quantile) regressions s = a + b*x (x = xa, xl, xb); F-tests vs (a=0,b=1) or (a=0.5,b=0); Wilcoxon signed-rank
Table 3: Wilcoxon signed-rank grouped by relative contribution and by most-favourable principle
ESM Appendix B: hurdle model (probit + Papke-Wooldridge fractional response), M-estimators (Tukey Biweight)
ESM Appendix C: most-favourable-principle threshold derivations q0=3/7, q1=0.6

raw_data_availability.supplementary: ESM_MOESM1.pdf (media.springernature.com, 766 KB) — contains Appendix A (instructions), B (hurdle/M-estimators), C (thresholds). NO raw per-subject data.
raw_data_availability.paper_statement: Electronic supplementary material 'available to authorized users'; 'complete test is available on request' (refers to the questionnaire, not the data).
raw_data_availability.verdict: DATA-NA : no raw dataset or analysis code obtainable by a third party.

reimplementation_scripts.job: Extract ESM PDF text via pdftools

reimplementation_scripts.reimplements: Pooled-mean derivation, (s-xa)/(s-xl) from cell means, fn13 BL t-test, fn14 KS p, W(z)<->p and F(df)<->p mappings, q0/q1 thresholds, cell-count decomposition, pooled min/max consistency
Independent second-language recompute (Python 3.8 + scipy) of the same derived checks
